title: Loop guard per subject
description:
Agents wake each other by changing records, so two agents could pass a Story back and forth. Keep the existing guard and make it general: a counter of agent runs per subject since a person last acted on it. The limit is an owner setting in the agent policy document; at the limit nothing more starts for that subject and one hard-gate review request says so. A person's action resets the count. An agent's own new version wakes free checks, and never the same paid step on its own output.

**Acceptance criteria**
- A ping-pong between two agents stops at the owner's limit with one hard gate.
- A person's edit resets the count.
- An agent never re-runs its own paid step on the version it just wrote.
- Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs (below).

**Gherkin features needed**
- agent-loop-guard.feature: two agents alternating stop at the limit; the hard gate is raised once; a person's action lets work continue; an agent's own version does not re-wake it.

**Infrastructure as code touched:** None.

**Part of:** Inbox: change feeds, the wake queue and one worker. Slice code B7 in `docs/design/always-on-agents-architecture.md` (section 12).
**Standing rules:** no fallbacks, no workarounds, no interim systems, no arbitrary caps; no text in DynamoDB; indexes over scans; no AppSync subscriptions; nothing created by hand in AWS; no real email addresses in specs or fixtures; status shown as words and marks, never colour alone.
